name: mak-unyil-store
description: Landing page statis Mak Unyil — build CSS Tailwind lokal, tanpa CDN.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-content.js && node scripts/build-images.js && tailwindcss -i src/tailwind.css -o assets/site.css --minify && node scripts/prerender.js && node scripts/cache-bust.js
scripts.publish: npm run sync:r2 && npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy . --project-name=mak-unyil-store
